basic_info.description: Charmingly old world style Portola District home that will steal your heart!! Well kept original condition with period details, and featuring fresh paint and flooring.  Bright and sun drenched, note the delightful views from the rear. There is a fantastic large yard with fruit trees. In addition,  it features an unfinished, regular ceiling height full basement, perfect for your future plans or use it as large garage for one plus cars! This delightful home has been family owned and loved since it was built. The short street is filled with charming houses and it's only half a block to the Portola's Palega Recreation Center & Park with its playgrounds, sports fields and gym.  It has easy freeway access, is close to Silver Ave. and grocery shopping. Muni and schools are close by too. Truly an extra special and remarkable home, this is a  rare & unique opportunity!
